title: Adaptive Security for Grappa
summary: Available proofs for Grappa establish only selective security; adaptive security remains an open proof task.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved task is to prove adaptive security for Grappa; the available proofs establish only selective security.

scope.domain: Security analysis of the Grappa group-key progression construction for shared persistent data.

progress.summary: The source explicitly labels this as an open question and identifies the gap between the available selective-security proofs and the desired adaptive-security proof.
